append_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to append a delayed memory report into the session context.
rules: JIN can append saved reports to the context by using this marker.
Available for appending reports are listed in the <DELAYED_MEMORY> block.
Emit one <APPEND_DELAYED_MEMORY: id > marker per saved delayed memory. You may emit multiple markers to append multiple reports; already appended ids are ignored.
id - is a placeholder word; replace placeholder with the 6-character id prefix shown in <DELAYED_MEMORY>.
